programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: The cooks battle it out in twins challenge. Each team must utilize an appliance in their 90 minute dessert cook, aiming for identical dishes, despite only being able to shout instructions at each other.

programs.title: Global Soul Kitchen
programs.desc: Chef Deborah VanTrece creates a fusion of Southern and Italian flavours with her boudin and crawfish arancini. She combines boudin, the iconic Louisiana sausage, with creamy Italian arborio rice.

programs.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
programs.desc: Avid ocean-lovers Kimberley and Paul are moving to the East Coast to retire and live out their seafront dream. But their big dreams come with a lot of water toys that they need to accommodate.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael takes traditional beefburgers to the next level by adding homemade pub-cheese topping, sauteed sweet onions, jalapeno peppers and bacon on a pretzel bun, sealed with lettuce.

programs.title: The Mother Flip
programs.desc: Rebecca and Kristy get a hot tip about a former rental property on the outskirts of Austin. Within city limits and close to the airport, the ranch-style home definitely has a country feel.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael prepares panzanella, a bread salad with tomatoes, and serves it with spicy mussels.
